path.style: fill: none; stroke: #dee5eb; stroke-width: 0.8; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-linecap: square

g.text: All panels have 10 people. Cells show the percent change in RMS error relative to typing a number.
Negative values favor the scale format; positive values favor typing a number.
These are descriptive comparisons for nine fixed images, not nine independent experiments.
The overall curve gives each image equal weight before taking the square root.
Source: Honda, Kagawa & Shirasuna (2022) | Data: osf.io/sxdf9 | Analysis: 23 Sep 2026
